research_scope: Provenance-aware relationship coverage in authoritative ISRO mission documentation
design_principles: Create an entity only when a collected primary source names or describes it.
Treat named mission science instruments as Payload unless the source distinguishes an instrument from a payload.
Do not infer developer, operator, target, or mission-sequence relationships from co-occurrence.
Store source-native names as aliases and keep one canonical ID per resolved entity.

entity_types.name: Mission
entity_types.description: An ISRO-led spacecraft or human-spaceflight mission represented in the curated mission set.
entity_types.source_requirements: An official ISRO or ISSDC mission page, mission document, or launch archive entry.

entity_types.name: Spacecraft
entity_types.description: A named vehicle or spacecraft explicitly described as part of a mission.
entity_types.source_requirements: A primary source must explicitly name the spacecraft or mission component.

entity_types.name: Payload
entity_types.description: A named scientific payload or onboard science instrument as the source labels it.
entity_types.source_requirements: A primary mission or payload source must explicitly list or describe it as carried/onboard.

entity_types.name: LaunchVehicle
entity_types.description: A named launch vehicle or mission-specific launcher configuration.
entity_types.source_requirements: An official ISRO launch archive, launcher page, or mission document must identify it.

entity_types.name: LaunchSite
entity_types.description: A launch complex explicitly identified as the origin of a mission launch.
entity_types.source_requirements: A primary launch record must state the launch site; an alias requires an official source.

entity_types.name: Organization
entity_types.description: An organization explicitly credited with developing, operating, or leading a mission or payload.
examples: Inter-University Centre for Astronomy and Astrophysics
entity_types.source_requirements: A primary source must state the organizational relationship; names are not inferred from acronym similarity.

entity_types.name: ISROCentre
entity_types.description: An ISRO centre/unit or Department of Space centre explicitly identified in official institutional documentation.
entity_types.source_requirements: An official ISRO centres directory or centre profile must identify the centre.

entity_types.name: Date
entity_types.description: A source-stated calendar date attached to a mission launch or documented event.
entity_types.source_requirements: A primary source must state the date. Date normalization must preserve the source display value.

entity_types.name: Orbit
entity_types.description: A named or explicitly characterized orbit occupied or targeted by a spacecraft.
entity_types.source_requirements: A primary source must explicitly associate the mission or spacecraft with the orbit.

entity_types.name: ScientificObjective
entity_types.description: A source-stated scientific or technical objective of a mission or payload.
examples: demonstrate safe and soft lunar landing
entity_types.source_requirements: The statement must occur in an identified objective section or be explicitly called an objective.

entity_types.name: ScientificTarget
entity_types.description: A source-stated body, region, or scientific subject observed or studied by a mission or payload.
entity_types.source_requirements: A primary source must explicitly state the target or observation subject.

entity_types.name: PlanetaryBody
entity_types.description: A named natural body explicitly studied, orbited, or used as a reference by a mission.
entity_types.source_requirements: A primary source must identify the body in mission context.

entity_types.name: Phenomenon
entity_types.description: A named physical or astronomical phenomenon explicitly measured or studied by a payload.
entity_types.source_requirements: A primary source must explicitly state that a mission or payload observes, measures, or studies it.

investigated_but_not_included.name: Instrument
investigated_but_not_included.reason: The collected mission sources generally use payload and instrument interchangeably for onboard science hardware. A separate class is deferred unless a source explicitly distinguishes a nested instrument.

investigated_but_not_included.name: Person/Scientist
investigated_but_not_included.reason: Not needed for the research question; no person-level relationship will be represented.

investigated_but_not_included.name: Location
investigated_but_not_included.reason: The launch-site class is sufficient for the launch-location questions in scope; adding generic locations would duplicate site entities.

investigated_but_not_included.name: LaunchEvent
investigated_but_not_included.reason: Each launch fact is attached to the mission and a typed Date; a separate event node is deferred to avoid redundant one-to-one nodes.

investigated_but_not_included.name: Dataset/DataProduct
investigated_but_not_included.reason: Official archive and data-product sources were investigated, but dataset identity is outside the initial relationship-coverage scope and is not needed for the selected triples.
